fields.name: id
fields.description: Card identifier. Major arcana: "fool", "magician", "death". Minor arcana: "ace-of-cups", "seven-of-wands", "queen-of-swords", "king-of-pentacles". Casing and separators are flexible, so "Fool" and "ACE_OF_CUPS" both resolve, and a leading definite article is optional, so "the-star" resolves to "star". The canonical form, and the one every response echoes, is kebab-case with no article.
